title: Projects & Mastery Practice 2
statement:
Module 6 (Projects & Mastery) covers: testing your code, debugging strategies, reading documentation, version control basics, asking good questions, capstone project. Solve this practice problem using what you learned.

Exercise 2: write a small program that demonstrates one concept from this module (Debugging Strategies).
hints: Re-read the Debugging Strategies lesson example.
Start by declaring your variables, then add the core logic.
Test with the simplest input first, then edge cases.
solutionExplanation: A correct solution applies the module concepts in a small working program.
